subject: Pricing pathways: Starter / Growth / Enterprise annual token commits
messages:
From: Jordan Holt <jordan.holt@rediant.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Suresh <priya@vertica.ai>
Date: 2025-05-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Intro — usage patterns & annual commitments

Karthik,

Thanks for the demo earlier — Jordan and I chatted and we think Redwood could be a fit for a hosted inference layer for our public APIs. Before we take a more formal POC, could you send high-level pricing/commit options for annual token commits? Our usage is mostly steady with a couple of bursty spikes around product launches.

Key asks:
- Simple chart showing Starter / Growth / Enterprise commits and the associated per-token pricing tiers
- How overage is handled (per-token or throttled)
- Any minimum contract length/termination terms we should expect

Appreciate a quick note — we want to present to finance next week.

—Jordan
Jordan Holt
Head of Platform, Rediant

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Holt <jordan.holt@rediant.com>
Cc: Priya Suresh <priya@vertica.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — usage patterns & annual commitments

Jordan — great to connect. High level attached (pricing matrix). Summary below for quick review.

TL;DR: We offer three annual commit pathways that balance price vs flexibility. Overage is per-token at a higher unit rate, but customers can opt into paid burst pools or auto-top-ups to avoid throttling.

Starter (10M tokens/yr) — for early-stage products- Effective per-token: $0.00012- 6 month notice to scale up; 30 day termination window after year one- No dedicated capacity; shared pool

Growth (100M tokens/yr) — predictable mid-market usage- Effective per-token: $0.00008- Quarterly review + scaling credits for predictable growth- Option to add limited dedicated concurrency

Enterprise (1B+ tokens/yr) — committed throughput + SLAs- Effective per-token: $0.000045- Custom SLA, dedicated pools, regional isolation- Volume rebates tied to multi-year commits

Overage: billed monthly at a surcharge (Starter: +45%, Growth: +25%, Enterprise: +10%) unless you pre-purchase burst capacity.

I've included a sample annual payment schedule and an Excel that maps your expected monthly cadence to recommended tier.

If you want, Marissa can run a quick modeling call to map your telemetry to the three options.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2025-05-15_pricing_matrix.xlsx (pricing matrix & cadence model)

From: Priya Suresh <priya@vertica.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Holt <jordan.holt@rediant.com>
Date: 2025-05-14T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — usage patterns & annual commitments

Thanks Karthik — quick clarifying Qs after reviewing the sheet: 
1) For Growth tier, does the quoted per-token assume 8k context average? Our bursts hit ~16k tokens on a few endpoints.
2) Can we split the commit across two orgs (public API + internal analytics) but share a pooled commitment?
3) On termination — what happens to unused committed tokens if we decide to pause product?

Jordan & I are available on Friday for Marissa's model run.

—Priya
VP Product, Vertica.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Suresh <priya@vertica.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Holt <jordan.holt@rediant.com>
Date: 2025-05-15T10:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — usage patterns & annual commitments

Priya — quick answers inline and proposing a short modeling session: 

> 1) For Growth tier, does the quoted per-token assume 8k context average?
Yes — our internal pricing assumes a 8k average request. For 16k average, the effective cost rises ~12-18% depending on batching improvements. We can model your exact distribution in the call.

> 2) Can we split the commit across two orgs but share a pooled commitment?
Yes — we support a single contract with multiple billing entities. We model the commit as a pooled token budget; invoices can be split by org with a single MOU.

> 3) On termination — what happens to unused committed tokens if we pause product?
Unused tokens are eligible for rollover up to 20% into the next period for Growth/Enterprise; Starter has a 60-day window to consume unused tokens. For longer pauses, we typically negotiate a credit or a short-term suspension clause in the MOU.

Call: Fri 2025-05-16 10:00 PT — I can run the model and share a draft MOU afterward.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Holt <jordan.holt@rediant.com>, Priya Suresh <priya@vertica.ai>
Date: 2025-05-15T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Intro — usage patterns & annual commitments

Stephanie — looping you in for quick executive alignment on the lower bound we can offer for Growth vs Enterprise. Jordan has indicated finance will push back on the list Enterprise entry point (1B tokens). They want a middle-ground proposal that gives meaningful savings at ~300M tokens.

Notes for you:
- Vertica expects a steady 300M annual baseline but with bursts up to 600M in product launches.
- They care about predictable unit economics and a small rollover window (20% acceptable).
- They asked about splitting across public/internal teams (we support pooled).

Can we offer a contra-priced Growth+ slab at 300M with a blended per-token of $0.00006 and a 12-month MOU with a 90-day scale-up notice? Need clarity on approval timeline — Jordan wants pricing to present to finance on Monday.

Thanks,
Karthik

Date: 2025-05-16T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — usage patterns & annual commitments

Karthik/Marissa — quick decision: we can support a custom Growth+ 300M slab with these guardrails: 
- Blended unit: $0.00006 per token for committed 300M/yr (12-month MOU)- Overage: charged at Growth surcharge (+25%) unless burst pool purchased- Rollover: up to 20% of unused annual commit to next year- Scale-up: 90-day notice to guarantee dedicated concurrency; we can provide temporary burst credits for launch windows (pre-purchased)

Conditions: require standard MSA + an MOU that defines billing entities and a mutual action plan. Sales to propose a short pilot (30 days) at 10% of expected monthly volume to surface any integration issues — pilot cost credited to first invoice.

Jordan/Priya — if that works, Karthik please send an MOU draft and I'll sign off on exec discount. We can also include a clause for a one-time placement credit if they commit to a 24-month extension within 90 days.

—Stephanie
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2025-05-16_mou_draft.pdf (MOU skeleton — billing, rollover, termination)
